name: mosaic
description: Mosaic, the everything app: tasks, calendar, habits, money, food, gym and notes in one SQLite-backed app with a chat-first UI and an MCP server.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web && npm run build:demo --prefix web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.screenshots: npm run build:demo --prefix web && npm run screenshots --prefix web
